data.name: Awena
data.gender_notes: Awena is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Awana’, meaning ‘gentle’, ‘loving’, or ‘soft’. This name evokes images of kindness and compassion. In Islamic culture, Awena is a reminder of Allah’s infinite mercy and love towards His creation. The name Awena carries the meaning “Gentle, loving” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awena usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, loving and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Awena belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, loving.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awena total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
